work.name: Yang Lab of Computational & Systems Biology, Rutgers University
work.summary: Developing computational and bioinformatic approaches for complex disease biology and spatial multi-omics.
highlights: Apply single-cell and multi-omics analyses to disease systems including melanoma and brain disorders such as Down syndrome-associated Alzheimer's disease.
Develop methods for emerging spatial transcriptomics and spatial multi-omics data, including cell segmentation, cell-state inference, and cell-level reconstruction.
Contribute to biodata-driven research using statistical modeling, machine learning, and reproducible computational workflows.

work.name: Department of Cell and Molecular Biology, Karolinska Institutet
work.summary: Single-cell and spatial analysis projects supervised by Prof. Jean Hausser.
highlights: Developed bioLUCID, a hypothesis-driven variance decomposition framework to distinguish technical batch effects from biological signal in single-cell transcriptomic integration.
Proposed the qsh/qsp ratio to independently measure batch-driven and biological variation on a common benchmarking scale.
Built the Tumor Promoting Microenvironment Characterization model for triple-negative breast cancer multiplexed imaging data.
Engineered patient-level features across 41 TNBC patients and modeled associations with tumor growth using beta-regression.

work.name: Department of Neurosurgery, Duke University
work.summary: Spatial transcriptomics method development supervised by Prof. Yi Zhang.
highlights: Co-developed STHD, a probabilistic machine learning method for cell typing in high-resolution whole-transcriptome spatial data.
Designed benchmarking analyses comparing STHD with existing spatial cell-typing methods across simulated, public, and patient-derived Visium HD datasets.
Implemented spatial cell-type mapping and biological interpretation workflows using high-definition spot-level cell-type assignments.

work.name: Department of Automation, Tsinghua University
work.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis of atherosclerosis and vascular remodeling diseases.
highlights: Integrated scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics data to reconstruct plaque microenvironment dynamics and identify cell states associated with instability.
Identified a disease-associated mononuclear phagocyte cell state and prioritized EGR1 as a candidate biomarker and therapeutic target for plaque instability.
Built a reproducible scRNA-seq analysis pipeline for cross-disease integration of 17 samples across 7 vascular remodeling diseases.
Combined SCENIC and protein-protein interaction analyses to compare regulatory and differentiation programs across disease contexts.

work.name: AirTsinghua
work.summary: Multi-omics data preparation and drug response modeling for cross-drug response evaluation.
highlights: Curated and harmonized public multi-omics data including RNA-seq, methylation, and CNV profiles to construct a patient-level training dataset.
Integrated cancer cell line sensitivity data from six public databases and used MCMC curve fitting to normalize drug-response measurements.
Generated analytical outputs and contributed figures and methods text to the DeepCRE arXiv preprint.

work.name: IDG/McGovern Institute, Tsinghua University
work.summary: Wet-lab and computational analyses of ATXN2/2L biology and circadian rhythmicity.
highlights: Generated and validated cellular perturbation models for ATXN2/2L biology, including stable U2OS knockout cell lines with polyglutamine length variation.
Purified ATXN2/2L proteins and used in vitro phase separation assays to test how polyQ expansion alters condensate behavior.
Developed a cerebellum-specific ATXN2/2L knockout mouse model through Cre-loxP and performed behavioral phenotyping.
Analyzed confocal imaging data and contributed visualizations supporting publication in Cell.

work.name: Tsinghua Laboratory of Brain and Intelligence
work.summary: Mouse modeling and behavioral neuroscience projects supervised by Prof. Yichang Jia.
highlights: Established and validated a Parkinson's disease mouse model using MPTP injection and rotenone administration.
Evaluated disease phenotypes through Open Field, Rotarod, and immunofluorescent staining assays.
Engineered a CX3CR1 knockout mouse model and prepared RiboTag bulk RNA sequencing samples to study learning and memory.
Performed quantitative image analysis of hippocampal microglia morphology and abundance using ImageJ.
